observations.behavior: Adds explicit instruction to inspect API responses alongside rendered state; requires checking response fields and re-snapping components.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes documentation for agent-browser testing workflow, not backend implementation.

observations.code_quote: Do not rewrite scopes or insert tokens into desktop storage to make login pass. If authorization succeeds but Desktop has no project, inspect the OAuth token scope and the `/api/users/@me/` and organization/project requests. That is contract evidence, not setup noise.
observations.behavior: Defines strict authentication and fixture seeding rules: do not bypass auth, seed database dependencies correctly, verify both HTTP status and JSON payload before asserting UI.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes operational guardrails for end-to-end tests against PostHog's authenticated APIs and Django stack.

observations.code_quote: Read Django logs for the exact exception when a request fails. Fix an in-scope PR bug and continue the same E2E run instead of ending at the first actionable failure.
observations.behavior: Prescribes debugging behavior during failures rather than stopping execution, supporting faster feedback loops.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports developer productivity by maintaining test continuity while fixing bugs.

observations.limitations: All changes are documentation-only within .claude/skills and references/. No production code, configuration, or migration was modified; tier cannot exceed 3 without demonstrated systemic change.
